name: San Jacinto County, TX
findings: San Jacinto County has 33 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, San Jacinto County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in San Jacinto County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
